mapper.sql: id, surrogate_id, `number`, `name`, parent_id, `level`, seq, status, remark, operator, operate_ip, create_time, update_time
a.id, a.surrogate_id, a.`number`, a.`name`, a.parent_id, a.`level`, a.seq, a.status, a.remark, a.operator, a.operate_ip, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select:
select
from where level like concat(#{level},'.%')

select a.id, a.surrogate_id, a.`number`, a.`name`, a.parent_id, a.`level`, a.seq, a.status, a.remark, a.operator, a.operate_ip, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.account as 'operator_name', c.`name` as 'parent_name' from sys_org as a left join sys_org as c on (a.parent_id = c.surrogate_id) left join sys_user as b on (a.operator = b.surrogate_id)
and a.surrogate_id = #{param.surrogateId}
and a.`name` = #{param.name}
and ( a.`number` like concat('%',#{param.keyWords},'%') or a.`name` like concat('%',#{param.keyWords},'%') or a.remark like concat('%',#{param.keyWords},'%') )
order by a.create_time
asc
desc

select a.id, a.surrogate_id, a.`number`, a.`name`, a.parent_id, a.`level`, a.seq, a.status, a.remark, a.operator, a.operate_ip, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.account as 'operator_name', c.`name` as 'parent_name' from sys_org as a left join sys_org as c on (a.parent_id = c.surrogate_id) left join sys_user as b on (a.operator = b.surrogate_id) where a.parent_id = #{param.surrogateId} order by a.seq asc
